meta.title: Audio Merger - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Merge multiple audio files into one. Adjust order and download as WAV.
mergeAtLeast: Add at least {count} files to merge
clippingWarning: Volume above 100% may cause clipping and distortion in the exported audio.
webmNote: WebM/Opus uses browser MediaRecorder — bitrate and sample rate are browser-controlled.
gateDesc: Silences signals below the threshold. Attack controls how quickly the gate opens; Release controls how quickly it closes.
rnnoiseDesc: Deep learning model trained on voice. Removes background noise while preserving speech clarity.
rnnoiseSrWarning: Your audio is {sr} kHz. RNNoise works best at 48 kHz — it will be automatically resampled.
rnnoiseFirstRun: First run downloads AI model (~100 KB)
steps_audio-merge_1Desc: Select two or more audio files to combine. Drag to reorder them in the sequence they should play. All files must be the same format.
steps_audio-merge_2Desc: Reorder files by dragging. Preview the total combined duration. Remove any file from the list before merging if needed.
steps_audio-merge_3Desc: Click Merge to combine all files into a single audio track. Download the merged file — ideal for podcast episodes, mixtapes, or audio compilations.
desc: Merge multiple audio files into one. Adjust order and download as WAV.
hint: Click or drag multiple audio files here (MP3 / WAV / OGG / AAC / FLAC / M4A, ≤50MB)
